pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/lib/athena/turn.ts:154 The user row is written before the model runs, and a mid-turn death or a thrown loop leaves that row with no closed result and no indeterminate status; a follow-up typed while the turn is in flight is dropped instead of joined at the model-call boundary.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/athena/turn.ts:154 appendTurn writes the user message first. On a thrown loop, turn.ts yields an error event and returns without an assistant row. Tool calls live only in the loop's memory, so an interrupt leaves a hole rather than a first-class unknown outcome.

src/features/shared/athena/AthenaComposer.tsx:26 The textarea stays enabled, but submit and useAthenaThread.send return immediately while sending. The draft is not drained into the running turn, not recorded, and a press during the turn is silent. The turn already has a durable append, so the no-record exception does not apply.

src/lib/athena/grounding.ts:242 Plan and read predicates are injected by the route. A thrown or absent skills predicate stays closed, and execute refuses every mutates tool, so the model cannot rewrite the gate's inputs.
src/lib/llm/tool-loop.ts:194 The loop calls the resolved runner directly. No contributed hook list, placement class, or compose-time order check exists.
src/lib/athena/turn.ts:284 The settled turn records the resolved engine and model. There is no hook assembly, declared hook identity, or procedure-versioned digest to compare.
src/lib/llm/tool-loop.ts:248 Each tool is awaited inside the leg and the string comes back before the next model call. No remote handle is persisted and the model is not given a poll.

src/lib/athena/turn.ts:190 History is complete message rows, replayed up to a fixed count. There is no full-versus-delta mode, marker, or ancestry walk. A failed history() becomes [] at turn.ts:181; that is a separate honesty gap, not this mode gate.
src/lib/athena/turn.ts:10 phase, recall, tool, settled, and error are the turn's own events. Nothing registers a contributed callback against them.
src/app/api/athena/[id]/message/route.ts:3 The message route is a host adapter. No contribution mounts a handler on it.
src/lib/athena/turn.ts:141 A search of src/lib/athena for spawn, subagent, and process.env found none. One turn does not start another run.
src/lib/llm/tool-loop.ts:80 Dispatch is one caller-supplied function. There is no observer registry and no mutator vocabulary for contributed code.
src/lib/athena/grounding.ts:49 The catalog is a static import, then filtered. No configuration key names code to load.
src/lib/athena/grounding.ts:284 Arguments are passed through after the plan checks. No contributed rewrite point exists.

src/lib/athena/grounding.ts:145 Tools differ by workspace plan, resolved per turn from injected predicates. A search of src/lib/athena found no process.env roster, and no tool exists only because of which UI client is attached.
src/lib/llm/tool-loop.ts:252 The only result path is execute's string, stored under the call's own id and name. No cache or alternate producer returns in the tool's place.

pairs.registryProposal: additive-input names supersede and inject, and its surface sentence says the send control is never disabled. A composer that leaves the textarea live, refuses submit while the turn runs, and drops Enter with no visible pending state is a third design the decision rules do not name.
